title: Ep1 stick v3 sample · ElevenLabs takes (retimed copy)
logline: Three excerpts rebuilt with the v3 changes: arrivals and aftermaths, Mas's inner voice, varied music, no pointers.

_edits.why: arrival: the bullpen room tone under the button before anything happens
arrival, and the introduction the plates did: who wants what, in his read

_edits.what: J-cut: "Okay, the build's green." starts 0.5 s under the wide
_edits.why: sound leads us into the conversation

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-01b "she'll go for three." after Rima's "Twice."
_edits.why: a read that the picture pays off in 5.07 (her third underline)

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-02 between Rima's question and "it's a preview."
_edits.why: the honest thought, then the public line; the gap is never explained

_edits.what: new held beat on Alyi (the 5.05 frame) with V.O. v3s-03
_edits.why: warmth for Alyi, and the trust Act Four breaks

_edits.what: +1.5 s after "let's see if anyone notices."
_edits.why: aftermath: the two of them and the quiet button

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-04 after Gerg's "It likes everyone…"
_edits.why: he wants to be liked, and says so only to himself

_edits.what: V.O. "nobody noticed." -> "someone noticed."
_edits.why: present tense, in the moment: wonder, not a caught line

_edits.what: cut (v3-plan C5)
_edits.why: the drill repeats; the size reads in half the time

_edits.what: J-cut: Rima's line starts 0.6 s under the held tile
_edits.why: her voice pulls us back up to his face

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-06 "mostly the bill." after "it's the bill.", held 1.8 s
_edits.why: the gap between what he says and what he means; plants "mostly." (S5.05)
arrival: the suite, the Strip, the race weekend (answers the newcomer's "why Vegas?" with picture and sound)

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-07 "alyi set it up. probably just the budget." before JOIN
_edits.why: the one read he gets wrong, after we have just seen the board's plan: suspense by dramatic irony. Then silence inside him for the whole blow

_edits.what: 2.2 -> 4.6 s after "super."
_edits.why: aftermath of the act's biggest turn: the frozen tiles, the room, no score

_edits.what: cut: the WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW card
_edits.why: a pointer; his voice returning tells us we are back with him
arrival: the dark room at 2 AM, glass and lanyard

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-08, the hearts counted, then miscounted
_edits.why: the rhythm carries what he won't say: he loses count

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-09 "gerg. he'll say he's compiling." as the tile rings
_edits.why: a read the next line pays off; warmth

_edits.what: 3.5 -> 6.0 s after "He did both."
_edits.why: silence inside him: the held face and the room

_edits.what: V.O. v3s-10 "gerg never waits to be asked." after "Just in case."
_edits.why: the bible's planted line, now in present tense

_edits.what: 2.9 -> 5.5 s after "leave it open."
_edits.why: aftermath: the door ajar
